$comment: Provisional: the reference definitions of the implementation guide (Annex F and Sections 4.3, 5.4, 6.6, 7.11 and 8.8) stand in for [IMPL] Annex A until it arrives; work item D.3 replaces them. STATE.md lists this file under the provisional contracts.
title: Common definitions
description: The types that the descriptor, the envelopes and the runtime configuration share.

CatalogRef.description: A reference to an entry of the type catalog with its version, as descriptors and envelopes write it (guide Annex F.9).

KindPathRef.description: A reference to an entry of the type catalog with its version, as catalog entries, tokens and runtime configurations write it.

Duration.description: A duration in the ISO 8601 form, for example PT15M or PT0.2S.

Timestamp.description: An instant in UTC, in the RFC 3339 form.

Digest.description: A SHA-256 digest, over the canonical JSON form of RFC 8785 where the object is a JSON document.

Name.description: A lower-case name made of words joined by hyphens: object classes, KPI names, flows, hooks and bindings.

CamelName.description: A value of an enumeration written in lower camel case; the catalog or [IMPL] lists the values.

ObjectId.description: The identity of a managed object.

InstanceId.description: The identity of an agent instance: <domain>/<descriptor-id>/<local-id> (guide Annex F.9).

Generation.description: The generation of the producing instance.

ReasonCode.description: A reason code of the catalog, made of a family prefix and its words (guide Annex F.10).

EvidenceId.description: The identity of an observation or an insight used as evidence.

TraceParent.description: The W3C trace context of the cycle.

CompactJws.description: A JSON Web Signature in the compact form; the payload part is empty when detached.

Capability.description: One of the four capabilities of a tuple.

FlowKind.description: One of the four logical flows of a tuple.

LatencyClass.description: The latency class of an agent (guide Section 3.8).

Scope.description: The scope of a message: the version of the resolved view, the domain and the values of the scope tags, pseudonymized across trust boundaries.

view.description: The version of the resolved view of the scope that the message used.

InputQuality.description: The quality of the inputs a capability consumed: the lowest coverage and the greatest staleness among them, whether the input was degraded, and the inputs used.

FeatureSetRef.description: A feature service of the feature store and its version.

Condition.description: A condition in the fixed structure of [FW]: a group (all, any, not) over conditions, or a comparison of one named operand. The condition evaluator checks the structure, the declared operands and the depth (work item 0.3); a constraint names itself with id.

Operand.description: A literal, or a reference to a parameter, a metric or a feature named in the descriptor.
